_readme: Single source of truth for project cards (index.html) and prev/next links (projects/*.html). After editing, run: python scripts/render.py

projects.title: InvestTech Hackathon
projects.hook: Should WSP Global join Onesheet’s Serial Acquirers & Consolidators index? A tool that answers with evidence, not a stock pitch.
projects.keyResult: Verdict: admit WSP. Revenue grew ~15% a year vs ~7% for index peers, and free cash flow per share still grew ~16% a year despite dilution

thumbnail.alt: Dashboard decision page: verdict ADMIT, with peer quality, value per share and deal execution passing and index fit pending more data

projects.title: Predicting Quebec Startup Funding Round Size
projects.hook: What predicts how much a Quebec startup raises in a single round?
projects.keyResult: Tuned Random Forest: test RMSE $19.3M on 621 disclosed rounds; growth stage beats public backing as a predictor

thumbnail.alt: Box plot comparing funding round amounts with and without a public investor

projects.title: Causal Inference on Startup Failures
projects.hook: Does raising more money actually make a failing startup last longer?
projects.keyResult: High funding adds about +2.2 years of lifespan (95% CI 1.6–2.8); losing to tech giants shows no detectable effect

thumbnail.alt: Causal graph linking founding era, sector and business model to funding and lifespan

projects.title: Spotify Listening Dashboard
projects.hook: A live dashboard of my Spotify listening history as well as a tool to rediscover my liked but buried songs that I can filter and re-export to a new playlist in Spotify, supporting my DJ activity.
projects.keyResult: 827,800 minutes and 240,125 plays across 14,955 artists since 2013, built from my full Spotify streaming history, the Spotify Web API and Last.fm genres

thumbnail.alt: Dashboard overview: minutes listened, plays, top artist and top track for this month and this year, plus current top artists and recently played songs

projects.data: Personal Spotify streaming history export, Spotify Web API, Last.fm

projects.title: Letterboxd Film Dashboard
projects.hook: A live dashboard of my Letterboxd film diary, watching and rating stats as well as a personal tool to pick my next watch based on mood.
projects.keyResult: 241 films logged since 2023 at an average 3.53★; refreshes daily from my Letterboxd RSS feed and the TMDB API

thumbnail.alt: Dashboard overview: films watched this week, month and year, a 2026 challenge progress bar, and all-time favourite film posters

projects.data: Personal Letterboxd export + RSS, TMDB API
